CBBBioc

Bioconductor interface to Genentech’s CompBioBench — a benchmark of computational biology questions for evaluating LLM coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, …).

CBBBioc catalogs the question set (v1qs), locates the input files each question needs in cloud storage (cbb_url()), and stages per-question agent workspaces (cbb_setup_workspace()) in the same workspace/ + prompt.md layout used by compbiobench-runner. See the package vignette for a worked example.

Installation 

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("vjcitn/CBBBioc")

Question catalog

v1qs currently holds 100 questions across these domains:

Domain Freq
Epigenomics 20
Genomics 20
Machine Learning 7
Population Genetics 12
Single-cell 21
Spatial 2
Structure 1
Transcriptomics 17

73 of the 100 questions have one or more associated input files, retrievable via cbb_url() and stageable with cbb_setup_workspace().
